stemMd: A model predicts a plant height of 18 centimeters at week 2 and 42 centimeters at week 8. Assuming a linear relationship, what height does it predict at week 5?
explanationMd: The rate is (42−18)/(8−2)=4 centimeters per week. Week 5 is three weeks after week 2, so the prediction is 18+3(4)=30 centimeters.

distractorRationale.d: This uses an incorrect elapsed interval from week two.
distractorRationale.b: This adds the two given heights rather than interpolating.
distractorRationale.a: This is the total increase over six weeks, not the height at week five.
